bugs.error_message: Pressing Enter in the login page's email/password fields does nothing
bugs.root_cause: The passkey/magic-link/password login forms (backend/src/main/kotlin/com/adoptu/pages/LoginPage.kt) are plain divs with type="button" buttons, not a <form>, and the frontend only wired click listeners on the buttons - no keydown handling existed anywhere, so Enter had nothing to trigger. Verification was separately confounded for ~40 minutes by Chromium caching /static/js/common.js across every browser_navigate reload: the server sends ETag/Last-Modified but no Cache-Control, so the browser kept executing a stale pre-fix bundle across repeated same-session reloads even though the file on disk was correctly rebuilt each time. Confirmed via window.AdoptuLoginPage.init's live runtime function body differing from the on-disk build, resolved by force-loading the script with a cache-busting query string.
bugs.fix: Added setupEnterKeySubmit(inputId, buttonId) to LoginPageModule (frontend jsMain), wired via keydown listeners on magic-email, password-email, and password-password that call preventDefault() + click() on the corresponding button when e.key=="Enter". Rebuilt via :frontend:jsBrowserProductionWebpack and :backend:processResources, verified live via Playwright with a cache-busted <script src="...?v=timestamp"> reload and a real CDP-level Enter keypress that successfully navigated to /profile.

bugs.error_message: Wrong reference: EmailVerificationAttempts should be LoginAttempts
Registration page always shows "verification email sent, check your inbox" even when no email was actually sent - user requested it several times and received nothing
bugs.root_cause: POST /api/auth/registration-options's re-registration path (existingUser exists but not yet verified) called webAuthnService.resendVerificationEmail(existingUser.id) and discarded its Boolean return value, then unconditionally responded with the localized 'verification email sent' message. resendVerificationEmail() internally checks EmailVerificationService.canSendVerificationEmail() (a 3-emails/day cap enforced via EmailVerificationTokens/EmailVerificationAttempts) and returns false without sending once exhausted - so once a user hit the cap, every subsequent registration attempt silently did nothing while still claiming success. The identical rate-limit condition was already correctly handled on the login-with-password route (checks the boolean, reports 'daily limit' in the error) with an existing passing test - but no one had written the equivalent test for registration-options, so this sibling code path's bug went uncaught.
bugs.fix: Captured the resendVerificationEmail() boolean and branch the response: true -> existing 'verification email sent' message, false -> new 'verification email limit reached' localized message (en/es/fr/pt/zh) mirroring login-with-password's daily-limit wording. Added the missing test 'POST registration-options reports rate limit when daily verification emails exhausted' (mirrors the existing login-with-password test) to AuthRoutesE2ETest.kt. Verified live against a real Postgres-backed dev server: created an unverified user with 3 EmailVerificationAttempts rows already inserted for today, confirmed POST /api/auth/registration-options now returns the honest rate-limit message instead of a false 'sent' claim; confirmed a fresh unverified user with zero attempts still gets the normal 'sent' message (no regression). Full AuthRoutesE2ETest suite passes.
